text: Due to the Easter holiday, travel by metro and bus in Tbilisi will be free.

Due to the Easter holiday, the Tbilisi Metro will operate until 04:00 on April 12, and travel will be free from 23:00 on April 11 until 04:00 on April 12. The Tbilisi City Hall is disseminating this information.
In addition, by decision of the city hall, nine temporary bus routes were also established for April 12-13.
“Buses will transport passengers from 08:00 to 20:00 to the Mukhatgverdi, Vashlijvari, Kukia, New Kukia, Makhatta, Saburtalo, Ghrmaghele, Veli, and Varketili cemeteries.”

Buses will operate from the areas adjacent to the metro stations: “Marjanishvili,” “Delisi,” “Sarajishvili,” and “Varketili,” as well as from the upper exit of “Didube,” Station Square (directly opposite “Tbilisi Central”), Besarion Chichinadze Street (opposite Building No. 25), and from Varketili III Microdistrict — from the intersection of Shuamta and Abashvili streets.
“Citizens will be able to use the buses on the mentioned routes free of charge for two days,” the Tbilisi City Hall said in its information.
